newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Equitable of Iowa bid up.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Equitable of Iowa bid up.

text.p: Equitable of Iowa Cos was bid higher before Tuesday's market close following its takeover by Dutch financial services group ING Groep NV in a deal worth $2.2 billion.

Traders reported little activity in New York markets. "There's not much news in the papers and no important economic news until the PPI (the government's inflation-measuring Producer Price Index) on Friday," one said.
Equitable, which is being bought by ING for $68 a share, was bid at 63 from a Monday close of 57-3/8.
The deal is set to take effect in the fourth quarter pending shareholder and regulatory approval. ING closed Monday at 48-1/4 in New York.
In other active shares, Comcast Corp was traded at 20-1/2 from a Monday close of 21-3/16. The decline came after Merrill Lynch cut its rating for the cable operator to near-term accumulate from buy.
Merrill kept its long-term rating of buy for the shares.
Xpedite Systems Inc was bid at 19 from a closing price of 18-3/8. An investor group said late Monday it had submitted a proposal to buy the company for $22.50 a share.

Among other shares, Atlas Air Inc was trading at 30-3/8 from a closing price of 30-3/4, Amgen Inc was at 57-5/16 from a close of 57-1/4 and Nextel Communications Inc was at 21-3/8 from a close of 21-1/16.
